expectedTruths: The (N-1)-divisor sample covariance of data.csv equals impliedCovariance in population.json and the sample means equal the population means, to ~1e-12.

ML standardised loadings equal v1..v4 = .80,.75,.70,.65 and v5..v8 = .85,.80,.75,.70, the factor correlation equals 0.40, chi-square = 0 (to solver tolerance), df = 19 (36 moments - 17 free parameters).

Unstandardised solution: with the (N-1) divisor the ML estimates equal the population values (std-lv: loading_i = lambda_i * sd_i, residual variance_i = (1 - lambda_i^2) * sd_i^2). An estimator that uses the N-divisor sample covariance (lavaan default) returns variances and covariances multiplied by (N-1)/N = 499/500 (std-lv loadings by sqrt(499/500); marker-identified loadings unchanged); standardised values and chi-square are unaffected.
